propositions: test_ac0_blob_ref_roundtrips_through_remote deterministically fails with exit 128 on macOS when safe.bareRepository=explicit is injected via environment
git -C <bare.git> refuses implicit bare repository discovery under safe.bareRepository=explicit policy, but git --git-dir <bare.git> is always permitted
the test's _git() helper uses git -C which fails against bare fixtures under the explicit policy, even though the pushed object exists in the remote
test_ref_lock.py lacks the bare-repo-safe git helper pattern established in _git_upkeep.py and test_concurrency_regression.py which use explicit --git-dir naming
production _ref_lock code is not implicated as it never runs git -C inside a bare repository
fix requires adding a _bare_git helper to route bare-remote inspections through --git-dir instead of -C, matching prior art, making test portable to explicit policy
